title: Coarse-trust integration - HONEST timed cost (real FNO + M1 coarse trust)
measurement: wall-clock seconds, includes FNO forward + coarse checks every step + corrections; averaged over 10 test ICs
honest_notes: cost includes the coarse checks (nothing hidden)
error floor ~3% because the coarse monitor is permissive (lets FNO drift to ~10% before switching); hit-rate drops for targets <3%
wall-clock costs are noisy (averaged over 10 ICs); the ~2.5-3.6x gap vs numerical is well outside the noise
